title: Aurora Design System
tagline: A token-driven, theme-aware design system for product teams.
description: Aurora is a production-grade design system with semantic color tokens, fluid typography, and 60+ accessible React components. It ships with a living documentation site, Figma sync, and zero-runtime CSS.

docs.content:
# Aurora Design System

Aurora is a token-driven design system built for scale. Every color, spacing, and motion decision is encoded as a semantic token, so re-theming an entire product takes minutes — not months.

## Why this exists

This project was born out of a recurring frustration: existing solutions traded **calm** for **power**. Aurora Design System aims to deliver both — a tool that disappears when you're in flow, yet surfaces deep capabilities the moment you need them.

## Highlights

- Zero-config onboarding
- Built for edge performance
- Accessibility as a first-class concern
- Fully typed end-to-end

# Architecture

Aurora Design System is organized around three principles: **isolation**, **streaming**, and **graceful degradation**.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              Client (React)             │
│  ┌───────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌───────┐ │
│  │   UI      │  │  State   │  │ Sync  │ │
│  └─────┬─────┘  └────┬─────┘  └───┬───┘ │
└────────┼─────────────┼────────────┼─────┘
         │             │            │
         ▼             ▼            ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           Edge (Workers / Node)         │
│   Ingest → Validate → Route → Persist   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Tech stack

- React
- TypeScript
- Radix UI
- Tailwind CSS
- Storybook

# Features

## Core capabilities

1. **Real-time updates** — changes propagate in under 100ms via streaming.
2. **Offline-first** — a local queue replays mutations once connectivity returns.
3. **Granular permissions** — role-based access at the resource level.
4. **Audit trail** — every mutation is recorded with a cryptographic signature.

## Quality bar

| Metric         | Target       | Achieved     |
|----------------|--------------|--------------|
| p99 latency    | < 100ms      | 42ms         |
| Uptime         | 99.9%        | 99.97%       |
| Test coverage  | 80%          | 87%          |
| Bundle size    | < 100kb gzip | 68kb gzip    |

# Roadmap

## Shipped ✅

- Public beta
- Edge deployment
- Real-time collaboration

## In progress 🚧

- Plugin marketplace
- Native mobile SDKs

## Exploring 🔭

- AI-assisted authoring
- Multi-region replication

title: Lumen Analytics
tagline: Privacy-first product analytics with edge ingestion.
description: Lumen ingests millions of events per day at the edge, with sub-50ms p99 latency. It features a query builder, cohort retention, and a zero-cookie architecture that keeps user data on-device.
